newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka closes easier against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka closes easier against dollar.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed weaker on Thursday at 42.5250/5300 to the dollar in interbank trade after banks took interest in other currencies, dealers said.
The previous close was 42.5000/5300. The taka opened weaker at 42.5200/5400 per dollar, but deals were done in narrow range and around 42.5470.
"Banks took increased interest in trade in other currencies amid weakening of the U.S. dollar," said one dealer.
The interbank call money rates finished at 6.25 percent to 6.45 percent, down slightly from Wednesday's 6.5-7.0 percent.
